summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current selected bytes; validator-owned successor context required; selection hash excludes source bytes; context hash binds selection, current source hashes, snapshot, Locator result, decisions, predecessor; authority envelope binds ADRs/rules/policies/contracts/registries/successor kinds; stale freshness/query failures may degrade unrelated execution only when selection, authority, modules, read-set verify; publication failure never advances current/LKG or invalidates valid LKG; selection/authority/contract/command-test/policy/protected-path/source-integrity/Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid profile allows same-selection degraded successor, forbids publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published Knowledge, publication checks, semantic review; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop execution interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity remain strict
